05.11.2026. Verification does not expand the grids and does not reveal additional bits. The received image is used 83 solutions and the initial hypothesis key[i] = 2^(i−1) + (s[i] mod 2^(i−1)), 0 ≤ s[i] < n.

Before the calculation, all nine overlapping panels of five were recorded indexing 75,80,...,135. One cube is built on each The mobius is in four centered differences, all maximums are checked on the divisibility of monomes: reversibility of the coefficient modulo n weight W(M) ≥ n. Theorem SEQ-16 then rule out strict HG-L1 certificates in all degrees idealn,G), under any permissible order of monomes and correct reduction.

Exact output area: individual cube, given module, data variables, rectangular boundaries and a strict weighted criterion L1-Norms, not excluded Mobius model itself, roots, joint equations, more accurate description domains of permissible variables and other lattice methods.

Controls: one fixed Möbius chain with a matrix7,11;13,17), starting-state 19; single-state from SHAKE256 domain LSCREEN-01/null/20261105. Both have the same indexes These are arithmetic controls, not statistical power estimates. Obstacle check receives only observations; complete control states are used separately to check the cube and boundaries.

Disclosure of the cube is checked in two ways: operations on polynomials and the direct decomposition of four works of three affine forms Integer Identities of Standardization of the Ideal. LLL, Gröbner root-finding No inferences about the number of independent bits observed They are not simply summed up.

The inputs, hashes of code and protocol are stored before the computation Two of their adopted manifestos are checked by SHA-256 and the time of change. New results are written only in this folder. screen.py --verify reading It repeats a cheap memory check without changing the files.
